summary_text: Q1 2026 already reported May 7, 2026 — pro forma adj sales $421.2M (+3%), pro forma adj EBITDA $82.1M (-16%, 19.5% margin), GAAP net loss $235M. Mixed segments: CompoSecure record ROS-driven; Husky hurt by oil/resin volatility and tariffs. Maintained 2026 guide: $1.95B-$2.1B pro forma sales; $550M-$610M EBITDA. Board declared $0.0025 dividend (May 6, 2026, pay June 1). Forward catalysts: stabilizing revenue growth, cash burn management, continued ROS deployment, Husky operational fixes. Next earnings date not specified in results — typical Q2 reporting would be early-Aug 2026.
